children: LONDON (dpa-AFX) - Halma (HLMA.L) issued trading update ahead of half year end on 30 September 2026. The Group said it has made strong progress in the first half of the fiscal year. The Group continues to expect low double-digit percentage organic constant currency revenue growth for the year as a whole. Adjusted EBIT margin in full year 2027 is now expected to be in the range of 23.5% to 24%. This compares to previous guidance for margin to be in line with the 2026 financial year at around 22.7%. The Group said the guidance is supported by order intake which remains ahead of both revenue in the year to date and the comparable period last year.
The Group's results for the half year will be released on 19 November 2026.
At last close on LSE, Halma shares were trading at 3,596.00 pence.
